subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public `MemoryRerankProvider` plugin SDK seam with a `memoryRerankProviders` manifest gate, exclusive single active provider, and builtin-only v1 scope?
rationale: The implementation looks coherent, but once released it becomes third-party plugin API and cannot be treated as routine code cleanup or an autonomous repair choice.

options.title: Approve Seam After Rebase
options.body: Approve the public API direction, require conflict resolution that preserves current-main abort behavior, and then merge after exact-head validation.

options.title: Revise Contract Shape
options.body: Ask for a different provider selection, manifest declaration, or qmd-scope design before exposing the SDK surface.

options.title: Pause Behind RFC
options.body: Keep the PR parked until maintainers settle https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89477 or choose a different reranker direction.

recommendation.title: Approve Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the public API direction, require conflict resolution that preserves current-main abort behavior, and then merge after exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about plugin SDK and memory/plugin boundary direction, and history shows steipete authored adjacent plugin capability and memory boundary refactors.
